## Writing a component in `libs/ui`

- Model new components on `atoms/button/button.component.ts` (the reference impl).
- **Wrap ng-zorro** when its behaviour / a11y / overlay handling is worth reusing
  and its surface can be re-pointed at tokens (`ds-select`). **Build native**
  when ng-zorro's compiled `.ant-*` specificity would pin the Ant palette and
  defeat runtime brand switching (`ds-button`).
- Do **not** put `<ng-content>` inside `@if` / `@switch` / `@for` — Angular
  projection breaks for repeated instances. Project into the host and switch
  semantics via attributes instead (see `atoms/text`).
- Export every public component/type from `libs/ui/src/index.ts`.
- Keep `ng-zorro-antd` a **peer** dependency of `@brand/ui` (CI enforces this).
- Add a `*.stories.ts` (a `Playground` + a variants gallery) and a `*.spec.ts`
  (behaviour + a11y attributes).
